# Crucial 2TB T705 NVMe PCIe 5.0 M.2 Internal SSD with White Heatsink

Key Features

- 2TB Capacity
- M.2 2280 Form Factor
- PCIe 5.0 x4 Interface
- 14,500 MB/s Max Read Speed

Enhance the speed and performance of your desktop or laptop with this Crucial 2TB T705 NVMe PCIe 5.0 M.2 Internal SSD with White Heatsink. Based on the PCIe 5.0 x4 interface, this M.2 2280 solid-state drive provides you with read speeds of up to 14,500 MB/s and write speeds of up to 12,700 MB/s, ensuring quick data transfer rates which increases loading speed while providing you with ample storage space. Micron 232L 3D TLC NAND controller and flash memory ensures your information is properly stored and recalled within a moment's notice, boosting the overall performance of your applications and even games. Experience a long-lasting lifespan with a massive endurance (TBW) rating of 1200TB and Mean Time Between Failure (MTTF) of 1.5 million hours. Additionally, the included heatsink properly dissipates heat quickly and efficiently, preventing thermal throttling and damage caused by extreme heat.
